# IEDC IDEA SPRINT 2026

> A 24-hour student ideathon and venture sprint hosted by IEDC BOOTCAMP CEC at College of Engineering Chengannur.

IEDC IDEA SPRINT 2026 brings together student innovators, product designers, and aspiring entrepreneurs to pressure-test bold technological concepts, receive industry mentorship, and pitch transformative ventures.

## Key Event Details
- **Event Name**: IEDC IDEA SPRINT 2026
- **Organizer**: [IEDC BOOTCAMP CEC](https://iedc.ceconline.edu/#about)
- **Institution**: College of Engineering Chengannur, Kerala - 689121
- **Venue Directions**: [Google Maps Destination](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=College%20of%20Engineering%20Chengannur%208J88%2BWXQ%2C%20Engineering%20College%20Road%20opp.%20FEDERALBANK%20Alapuzha%20District%2C%20SH%201%2C%20Chengannur%2C%20Kerala%20689121)
- **Plus Code**: 8J88+WXQ
